Delhi Traffic Police Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

1. Advance Notice (2 km out)

When the ambulance is approaching, the system warns the red light intersection. Alert status switches to PENDING.

2. Traffic Clearance Action

Duty officer presses "Clear Corridor". Traffic signals turn Green on the ambulance lane and hold cross-traffic.

3. Status: RESOLVED

Crowd disperses before ambulance arrives. Zero stops, non-stop safe transit for the patient.
